transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. 

Honestly, what made me come in is that I just... I keep getting up during our long sales strategy meetings. I know I’m supposed to stay seated, but I end up finding excuses to get up and refill my water, or... or I'll just pace by the printer. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized or 'up' while this was happening?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I feel 'up' or anything. Just... normal, I guess.
Did you have this same kind of hard time staying seated when you were a child?

Yeah... I mean, it's not a new thing. 

I guess... well, even in elementary school, my teachers used to write on my report cards that I was bright but I rushed through things. And... I talked out of turn a lot. I was always forgetting my homework, and my desk was just... full of half-finished papers. So, yeah, it's been going on since way before high school.
Do you ever pull out your hair?
Um... no. I don't do that.
Do you often feel excessively worried or on edge?
No... not really. I mean, I don't think so. Just the usual stuff, I guess. I wouldn't say I'm on edge.
